dialogues.speaker: Ancient Text (III)
dialogues.text: "...I spoke to the master about certain matters. I have a bad feeling, although they are usually wrong. This kind of thing should be Fujin's specialty..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Text (III)
dialogues.text: "...Still, I should take some precautions... I'll split some adeptal energy off and inject it into the butterflies... Their lifespan will extend greatly..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Text (III)
dialogues.text: "...Then, even if something were to happen, the mortals of Chenyu Vale may be able to follow their guidance and find the formulae I left behind..."
